newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit weakens vs dollar, seen testing 2.52.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit weakens vs dollar, seen testing 2.52.

text.p: The ringgit weakened against the dollar in Asian trading with renewed dollar buying by offshore players limiting the ringgit's rise, dealers said.
They said dollar/ringgit may again test the 2.5200 level later in London though fears of central bank intervention were likely to cap its topside.

"Dollar/ringgit broke through the 2.52 level in London overnight and again in Sydney this morning. It should test 2.52 again later in London or New York," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank. He said the dollar rise in Sydney was a result of an attempt to trigger stop-loss sales at just above 2.52.
